Bug: packages/functions/src/services/lightHouseService.js getAuditResultByLightHouse (~L88-155) returns `ran: !!lightHouseResult`. A PageSpeed/Lighthouse result that carries `runtimeError` (e.g. {code:'NO_FCP'}, 'FAILED_DOCUMENT_REQUEST') or has no/empty `audits` is truthy, so `ran` is true while getImagesToCompress returns [] and hreflangValid null. helpers/seoSpeed.js:478 counts `lighthouseRan` from `page.ran`, and the checklist issues imageDelivery / lcpImage / jsLongTime then PASS for an audit that never ran (the exact failure FAL-945 set out to stop).
Fix: `ran` is true only when lightHouseResult exists, has no `runtimeError` (treat any truthy runtimeError as failure — Lighthouse sets it only on failure), and `audits` is a non-empty object. When it did not run, also return imagesToCompress [] / hreflangValid null as the catch path does, and logger.warn once with shopId, url and runtimeError?.code. Do not change getLightHouseData, fetchLightHouse, the password headers or the ssrf guard.
Test: new packages/functions/src/services/__tests__/lightHouseService.ran.test.js — mock exactly like lightHouseService.passwordHeader.test.js does (logger, storageService, config/app, @avada/core, helpers/seoSpeed, helpers/google, helpers/lighthouse/lightHouse, scriptManagerRepository; also mock helpers/lighthouse/checklistAudits if it pulls heavy deps). Cases: good result with audits → ran true; runtimeError NO_FCP → ran false; empty audits {} → ran false; null result → ran false. Drive getLightHouseData through the mocked getGooglePageSpeedScore (useGoogleApi:true, allowFallback:false).

Bug: packages/functions/src/services/audit/artifacts/storeResources.js reads whole-store checklist counts from Elasticsearch via readStoreResources (services/audit/storeScan.js:305) without checking the shop's search-index sync. A sync that failed (succeeded:false, chunks given up), is still running, or was stamped with an older checklistIndexVersion leaves a partial index that reads as the whole store, so meta/noindex items pass falsely. The FE gates on sync, but background/report scans do not. needsChecklistSync(job) in packages/functions/src/const/jobDataMigrate.js:24 is the existing predicate, and storeScan.js:516-517 refreshChecklistDocs already gates with `const {data: jobs} = await new JobDataMigrateRepository().find(shop.id, {}); if (needsChecklistSync(jobs?.[0])) return 0;` — reuse the same repository call and import path storeScan.js uses.
Fix: in storeResources({shopId}), before reading ES, load the job the same way; when needsChecklistSync(job) → logger.warn('[storeResources] search index sync incomplete, store items not checked', shopId) and return null (the artifact's documented 'notChecked' value). Keep the existing try/catch → null. Do not edit storeScan.js.
Test: new packages/functions/src/services/audit/artifacts/__tests__/storeResources.test.js. jest.mock with factories: '@functions/services/audit/storeScan' (readStoreResources), the JobDataMigrateRepository module (find), '@functions/helpers/logger'. Do NOT jest.mock const/jobDataMigrate — use the real needsChecklistSync and CHECKLIST_INDEX_VERSION. Cases: no job → null and readStoreResources not called; job succeeded:false → null; old checklistIndexVersion → null; synced current version → returns readStoreResources' result; repository throws → null.
